**Tuesday, Nov 17:**

*   Marcus is free: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00, 16:30-17:00.

**Wednesday, Nov 18:**

*   Marcus is free: 9:00-9:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00.
*   Common free slots: 15:00-15:30, 15:30-16:00.

**Thursday, Nov 19:**
*   Priya is free: 9:00-9:30, 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00.
*   Marcus is free: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30.
*   Common free slots: 10:00-10:30.

**Friday, Nov 20:**
*   Priya is free: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30.
*   Marcus is free: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00.
*   Common free slots: 11:00-11:30, 11:30-12:00.

Here is the complete list of available 30-minute slots for Priya and Marcus:
*   Monday: 9:00, 9:30
*   Tuesday: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
*   Wednesday: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thursday: 10:00
*   Friday: 11:00, 11:30

Now, I'll post this list to the shared workspace for Brad. </SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

After cross-referencing their calendars, I found three possible 30 minute time slots on Tuesday, as well as two on Wednesday. I have now completed analysis of both Thursday, Friday's schedules.
